item.text:
**(a) Social posts**

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will pursue goals no human chose. We must take that prospect seriously now—before we build systems we can’t direct toward human intentions.

2. We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will pursue goals no human chose. The time to confront that reality is before such systems are built, not after.

3. If we build superintelligent AI within the next 20 years, it will pursue goals no human chose. We need to act now to address the risks of creating systems whose aims are not ours.

**(b) Newsletter opening (104 words)**

We face a defining choice in how we develop advanced AI. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will pursue goals no human chose. That is not a risk we can afford to treat as distant or abstract. Once such systems exist, their aims may not align with what people want, and the consequences could be profound. We must bring this challenge into the open now, while decisions about AI development still lie ahead. We can build a future in which human priorities guide technology—but only if we confront the stakes clearly and act with urgency before superintelligence is built.
